verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms `https://exa.ai/llms.txt` returns HTTP 200 with an agent-oriented summary. Exa also serves `docs/llms.txt` and `llms-full.txt`, plus Markdown versions of its doc pages that point agents to the documentation index. The llms.txt content itself gives agent guidance (SDKs, the hosted MCP endpoint), and Exa ships agent skills that teach coding agents to build with its APIs. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually using these docs.
